documents.title: Notice Of Annual General Meeting Along With Annual Report For FY 2025-26

analysis.summary: Uniparts India Limited reported Q1 FY27 revenue growth of 27% year-on-year, EBITDA growth of 55% year-on-year, and PAT growth of 64% year-on-year, driven by operational rigor and favorable product and channel mixes. Management noted that construction equipment demand remains robust, while large agricultural equipment is at its cyclical bottom with recovery expected through calendar year 2027. The company maintains a strong balance sheet with a net cash position of approximately INR 190 crores and is actively evaluating value-accretive acquisition opportunities. Furthermore, the restoration of the Ludhiana facility finishing shop is on schedule and Mexico warehouse operations remain on track for first customer deliveries in Q3 FY27. Uniparts India Ltd reported financial results for the first quarter of FY27, highlighting year-on-year growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT.

guidance.claim: Management stated that FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points higher than the growth achieved in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.
guidance.quote: And keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: The company expects growth in FY27 to be in line with the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: The small agriculture segment in North America is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs have indicated that the year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom for large agricultural equipment, with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending in the U.S. and Europe is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility in the construction equipment segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the U.S. and the government-led investments in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: The aftermarket business represented approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.
demand_outlook.quote: Finally, our aftermarket business represents approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom for large agriculture, with recovery expected through CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket represented approximately 12 percent of revenues in Q1 FY27 and remained flat year-on-year in absolute terms.
demand_outlook.quote: Aftermarket represents approximately 12% of revenues in Q1 FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: India continues to perform well in small agriculture, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption across mid-to-higher horsepower categories.
demand_outlook.quote: India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility in construction equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Customers commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment in North America.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The European construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery.
demand_outlook.quote: Specifically coming to Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture market in North America is on the path of recovery led by livestock and dairy production.
demand_outlook.quote: The small agriculture market in North America is on the path of recovery. Livestock and dairy production is leading demand, while the higher end of the smaller ag sector range is also showing resilience.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agricultural machinery continues to work through the current down cycle with leading OEMs affirming that quarter 4 of '26 represents a cyclical trough.
demand_outlook.quote: Let me talk about the large agricultural machinery, continues to work through the current down cycle with leading OEMs affirming that quarter 4 of '26 represents a cyclical trough.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR 12 crores, focusing on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement, and customer-led growth initiatives.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations remain on track with the first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: The restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex stood at INR12 crores for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR 90 crores, registering a 55% growth year-on-year and 10% sequentially.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering strong 55% growth year-on-year and 10% growth sequentially, reflecting healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management across the business.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax stood at INR 57 crores, up 64% year-over-year and 11% quarter-over-quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR57 crores, up 64% year-over-year and 11% quarter-over-quarter, demonstrating strength of our operating performance and profitability profile.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects its cycle EBITDA margins to be about 20% over a peak-to-trough cycle.
margins_costs.quote: So Mr. Jain, when we talk about 20% margins, we are talking about 20% margins over a cycle which is peak to trough.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin was 66.6 percent of revenue from operations in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Profit Margin (As % of Revenue from Ops) 66.6%

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% for quarter 4 FY26 and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Operating leverage is now working in the company's favor with margins expanding meaningfully.
margins_costs.quote: So as the last year has demonstrated, operating leverage is now working in our Favor with margins expanding meaningfully.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crores with a healthy pipeline.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore, with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month business wins exceeded INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% quarter-on-quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: So if I talk about the strategic outlook, our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: New business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over the last 12 months.
orders_capacity.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

capital_allocation.claim: The net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at approximately INR 190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of 30th June.
capital_allocation.quote: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of 30th June, reflecting our near-shoring and warehousing-led business model while remaining broadly under control.

capital_allocation.claim: The net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, including a special dividend of INR101 crores declared in Q3 of FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores. In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility led to some demand skewing in the aftermarket segment as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate purchasing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Towards the end of quarter 3, one of the facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incident in the finishing shop.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty in March that required swift action.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the fabrication vertical will become a meaningful vertical within the next 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the aftermarket segment to normalize and return to growth over the next 12 months.
management_commitments.quote: And I think over the next 12 months, we do expect this to normalize.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that efforts are underway to rebuild the Ludhiana facility and be online by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: So, Sunil, the efforts are underway to rebuild and to be online by the end of the year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
